intervention: For each common-specialization-compatible class pair, recover a simultaneous first-order unifier of conflicting shared-variable images, apply that specialization to both otherwise matching source-law substitutions, independently construct and replay-check the two existing-law contextual equalities, install only that pair, and recompute closure/cross-distance.

decision_table.PASS_CLOSURE: a specialized existing-law pair closes the theorem and passes ablation
decision_table.PASS_2_TO_1_CAUSAL: a specialized existing-law pair lowers d from 2 to at most 1 and passes ablation
decision_table.REPRESENTATION_RESCUE_NO_CAUSAL_ATTACHME: the 10-cell compatibility rescue yields replay-valid specialized pairs but none contracts the real cut under the frozen intervention bounds
decision_table.NO_REPLAYABLE_SPECIALIZATION: matrix compatibility witnesses cannot be compiled into replay-valid specialized source-law interactions

scientific_rule: No new proof operator or operator family may be synthesized. Positive compatibility is attacked by compiling only its common specialization into already-available source-law contextual moves. A causal claim requires theorem-level contraction plus ablation.
